tagline: Outdoor power equipment and service for Timaru
heroSubheading: Outdoor power equipment and service for Timaru homes, farms and businesses.
aboutHtml:
We've been part of the Timaru community for many years, supporting homeowners, contractors, businesses and schools with outdoor power equipment and service. We stock the full range of STIHL plus Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda, Hansa Chippers and Hustler.

Our workshop is fully equipped with the latest diagnostics and staffed by factory-trained technicians. We service what we sell, and we service other major brands too. Everything comes delivered fully assembled and laid out in our bright, clean store so you get a real sense of the quality. If your tools are in for service, ask about trying our battery-powered equipment at home.

We're community-minded as well, proud sponsors and supporters of local groups and activities. Come in and talk to our team, or shop online for home delivery or click and collect.
servicesIntro: We service STIHL and other major brands from our fully equipped workshop with factory-trained technicians.
